verdict.rationale: Orb documents a first-party, real-time webhooks system that sends calls to a registered endpoint when certain events take place, so outbound HTTP callbacks exist. The evidence does not list which events are emitted, so coverage of renewal, upgrade, payment failure and cancellation is unconfirmed. The dunning retries in the docs are payment-charge retries, not webhook delivery retries, so they are not credited toward reliability. missing for 10: documented subscription lifecycle event types (renewal, plan change/upgrade, payment failure, cancellation), webhook delivery reliability guarantees (retries, signing/verification, idempotent delivery), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, every subscription state change — renewal, upgrade, payment failure, cancellation — emits a webhook or event my systems can act on reliably

citations.quote: Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
